captions.short_caption: Jupiter imaged by the Hubble Space Telescope
captions.caption: This full disk view of Jupiter was obtained on 21 April 2014 with Hubble's Wide Field Camera 3 (WFC3). It shows the prominent great red spot, a gigantic cyclone. Cloud ribbons cover the surface, whose colours stem from gases like ammonia and other chemical compounds.
captions.alt_text: The planet Jupiter with horizontal cloud ribbons and the great red spot
captions.credit: NASA, ESA, and A. Simon (Goddard Space Flight Center)
